column1: # The intended deviations of the corpus programs from the original
# The runs that compare with the original (ctest --preset originals:
# 2.10 compiler with the CD's libraries) and port (blitz2-c with the CD's
# libraries) against expect/PASS/NAME.out, and port's executable against
# ref's.  A fix of an original bug that changes a program's output or code
# lists the program here, in the fix commit:
# PASS: corpus, corpus_runerr, corpus_req, corpus_serial or
# corpus_serial_runerr; NAME: the source without .bb2 (the same program is
# listed once per pass it differs in); NNN: the issue of the fix.  A
# listed program may differ from the original ("noted #NNN" in the
# report); a difference of a program not listed fails, and so does a
# listed program that differs in no configuration (stale note).
